description.value: Hearthstone Artisan Bakery is an artisanal bakery in Nanaimo's Southgate Shopping Centre specializing in hand-crafted sourdoughs, specialty breads, and pastries made entirely from scratch using locally sourced and milled organic flours. Founded in 2015, the bakery prides itself on regional ingredient sourcing — flours from True Grain in Cowichan, honey from Cedar, and cheddar from Paradise Island. For a touring cyclist, it offers a genuine taste of the region with freshly baked goods ideal for refueling on the road.
